issues: 1. CLIPPING: Right labels at x=448 use fontSize 30, not 28. “Travel: illustrative” (21 chars, ~300px) reaches ~748, beyond x=616 limit; “Moves together” also clips. Shorten/move labels left or reduce font.

2. WRONG MOTION CLAIM: Narration/caption at 12s says control “compresses the assembly,” but the rigid group only translates: with ty=70, grip (y103–125), rod (125–220) and head (220–260) keep identical lengths/attachments. Say “lowers/translates the whole assembly.”

3. TRAVEL MARKERS MISALIGNED: Arrow/ticks span y142–298, but actual mover travel is ty 0→70 (e.g. head top y220→290, head bottom 260→330, leaving 14px above base top y344). Align arrow/ticks to a named part’s start/end positions.
"Gap stays" (x452,y350) is false: head bottom moves 260→330, so gap to base top y344 shrinks 84→14px. Relabel "14px gap remains"; marks at y330/y344 are correct.
Head/guide collision: head x230–410 overlaps right guide x400–430 throughout travel. Narrow/shift head to fit open channel x180–400, e.g. x240–390.
"Compression control" implies unsupported pressure/force science. Rename "Travel control"; other labels at x452/font28 fit within x616.

issues: Moving-part callouts are unparented/static: call-rod/head/grip stay at y175/240/114 while slide moves down up to 70px during their 6–12s display, detaching from rod/head/grip. Parent them to slide or show them only before motion.
Gap annotation disconnect: gap-mark correctly spans final head-bottom y326 to base y344 at x250, but “Gap small” sits at x452,y320 with no leader; add a leader to x250 or move label beside the mark.
lbl-guide has no leader and labels right guide only from x452; add call-guide from guide-r (x430,y200) to x448–452. Other labels ≤9 chars at x452 fit within x616.

Labels collide after travel: slide-parented Grip label moves 114→184, exactly overlapping fixed Guide label at (452,184); Head label moves to y310, overlapping Gap label at y320. Parent part labels/callouts outside `slide`, or offset them to avoid fixed labels.

Gap/clearance is wrong: head bottom moves 260→330, leaving 330–344 = 14, but `gap-mark` spans 326–344 (18) and overlaps the head by 4. Change its top/ticks to y330; do not claim the 14 gap “stays” throughout—it shrinks from 84 to 14.

Double drive risks collision: `compression` targets `slide.ty` by 70 and a separate track also drives `slide.ty` to 70; if combined, head bottom reaches 400, crashing through base at y344. Keep only one driver for the 70-unit travel.

Moving leader mismatch: head callout is fixed at y286 and grip callout at y168, while head/grip move +48; parent them to `movers` or fade before motion (6–16s).
False closing caption: at 18s ‘gap stays open’ is wrong after the 10px base collision above; fix travel first, then retain caption.
